scope: Additive TH18 Firespitter L1-L3 catalogue and partial projectile mechanics record. The directional burst is not materialized without a reproducible cone, scatter, projectile and hit-order contract.
game_version: The frozen structured payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Supercell confirms L3 as TH18 content without a client build; current secondary mechanics are version-unknown.

sources.title: The Town Hall 17 Update Is Here!
sources.limitations: Confirms defender-selected aim direction, a covered cone, air/ground eligibility, very fast fire rate and inaccurate shots which may hit troops behind the main target. It publishes no numerical cone, rotation, burst, scatter distribution, origin, projectile speed, collision, target order or tick timing.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: Confirms Firespitter L3 is a TH18 level. It provides no statistics or deterministic projectile contract.

sources.title: Home Village Firespitter structured payload
sources.limitations: Pins 3x3 geometry, two-at-TH18 count, L1-L3 values, 16 range, 0.064-second fire interval, 20-shot burst and 1.0167-second burst interval. It does not identify a current client build and contains no directional, scatter, collision or timing trace.

sources.title: Firespitter
sources.limitations: Reports straight-line projectile behavior, two hits per projectile, 20 shots, 0.064-second active interval, a 90-degree rotation increment and roughly 150-degree coverage. It has no current build, exact scatter sequence/distribution, cone boundary, collision geometry, target tie-break, projectile speed, origin or fixed-tick ordering.

value.confidence: primary qualitative + official TH18 availability; frozen structured numerical data; version-unknown secondary mechanics
not_materialized: placement direction and exact cone/acquisition boundaries
deterministic scatter distribution/sequence and target selection
projectile origin, speed, cross-altitude collision and two-hit intersection order
burst cancellation/retarget timing and displayed-DPS derivation
freeze, Rage, spell, trap, wall/collision and same-tick interactions
directed projectile rendering and snapshot/replay state

partial_mechanics_contract.note: The direct source table reports L3 51 damage per shot but 455 displayed DPS, while its interval is 0.064 seconds. This discrepancy proves that an inferred ordinary cadence/DPS proxy would be wrong; all numerical values remain data-only until the burst timing and projectile contract are reproducible.

support.note: Firespitter remains unavailable through Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshots and replays; a generic target-following projectile would contradict its documented fixed-direction, inaccurate, piercing behavior.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines exact aim-axis coordinates, cone edge, blind spot, target eligibility order or target ties.
No consulted source defines scatter values or random/deterministic seed, projectile origin/speed, hitbox/collision, air-ground intersection order, or exact two-target-pierce handling.

The source table's 0.064-second interval, 20 shots, 1.0167-second burst gap, damage/hit and displayed DPS cannot be reconciled without the hidden attack/burst scheduling; the current generic Core cadence cannot be substituted.
No source-verified current directed-projectile assets or animation-to-tick mapping was obtained.
conclusion: Firespitter L1-L3 is recorded with complete available provenance and TH18 L3 confirmation, but remains data-only and partial. No generic Core burst, projectile, direction or damage proxy is enabled.
